_what: School names and countries as listed by International Schools Review. ISR lists country + school name only; it never states the city. CITY is therefore INFERRED and every row records how.

_city_source_values.name: the city name appears verbatim in the school name (e.g. 'Luanda International School')
_city_source_values.fuzzy: the school name contains a near-miss spelling of a real city (e.g. ISR's 'Durress' -> Durres)
_city_source_values.fallback-largest-city: GUESS. The school name reveals nothing, so the country's largest city was assumed. Do not treat as fact.

_coordinates: City centroids from GeoNames via the geonamescache package. They are CITY centroids, not school addresses.
